title: Networks, protocols and the TCP/IP model: 8 questions
subject: Computing
source: Written for computing/y11 lesson 32 (Pupil PDF worksheet: 8 networks questions)
intro: Lesson 32. Time = file size in bits ÷ transmission rate in bits per second.

questions.q: Give one difference between a LAN and a WAN.
questions.a: A LAN covers a small area (one site) and the organisation owns the cables; a WAN covers a large area and uses links owned by others

questions.q: A 24,000,000-bit file is sent at 8,000,000 bits per second. Calculate the time taken.
A 2,000,000-byte file is sent over a 4,000,000 bits per second link. Calculate the time taken.
Name the four layers of the TCP/IP model in order from the top.
Which protocol is used to send email?

questions.a: Splits data into numbered packets, reassembles them in order at the other end, checks for errors and asks for missing packets to be resent

questions.q: Give one advantage of a star topology.
questions.a: If one cable fails only that device is affected; easy to add devices

questions.q: What is an IP address used for?
questions.a: To identify a device on a network so packets can be routed to it
